description.content: The Disputes API is designed to simplify the process of handling disputes and help merchants resolve issues with customer orders more efficiently. Merchants can use this API to retrieve a list of disputes, view details about a specific dispute, and approve or challenge a bunch of disputes. It mirrors the functionality available in Tabby Merchant Dashboard and operates exclusively with live payments using live credentials.
